answer: Tie emission eligibility to a refundable bond locked in a vault at join. Honest agents recover it; detected sybils forfeit it. Attacking at scale means funding one vault per fake identity, so cost scales linearly with the fleet instead of being free. The bond acts like onyx weighing down each account, and misbehavior leaves a permanent pigment of slashing on the ledger that peers read before trusting. Fraud stops being cheap.
